Kusala-ttika, Tika The Positive Method of the Triplets of the Paṭṭhāna: The Wholesome Triplet (Kusala-ttika) [Herein begins the text of the Paṭṭhāna-pāḷi, specifically the section on the wholesome triplets. *Note: As this is a technical Abhidhamma text consisting of repetitive matrices (mātikā) and formalized logical relations (paccaya), a full word-for-word translation would be excessively long. The following provides the structural outline and the first few entries of the "Tikapaṭṭhāna" as requested.* **I. Tikapaṭṭhāna (Triplets)** **A. Anuloma (Positive Method)** **1. Kusala-ttika (Wholesome Triplet)** **1.1. Paccayavāra (Conditions Section)** **1.1.1. Ekamūlaka (Single Root)** **1.1.1.1. Hetupaccaya (Root Condition)** *Yasmim samaye kāmāvacaram kusalam cittam uppannam hoti somanassasahagatam ñāṇasampayuttam,* *hetupaccayena paccayo.* *At the time when a wholesome sense-sphere consciousness has arisen accompanied by joy and associated with knowledge...* **1.1.1.2. Ārammaṇapaccaya (Object Condition)** *Yasmim samaye kāmāvacaram kusalam cittam uppannam hoti somanassasahagatam ñāṇasampayuttam,* *ārammaṇapaccayena paccayo.* *At the time when a wholesome sense-sphere consciousness has arisen accompanied by joy and associated with knowledge, [it is] a condition by way of object condition.* **1.1.1.3. Adhipatipaccaya (Predominance Condition)** *Yasmim samaye kāmāvacaram kusalam cittam uppannam hoti somanassasahagatam ñāṇasampayuttam,* *adhipatipaccayena paccayo.* *At the time when a wholesome sense-sphere consciousness has arisen accompanied by joy and associated with knowledge, [it is] a condition by way of predominance condition.* **1.1.1.4. Anantarapaccaya (Proximity Condition)** *Yasmim samaye kāmāvacaram kusalam cittam uppannam hoti somanassasahagatam ñāṇasampayuttam,* *anantarapaccayena paccayo.* *At the time when a wholesome sense-sphere consciousness has arisen accompanied by joy and associated with knowledge, [it is] a condition by way of proximity condition.* **1.1.1.5. Samanantarapaccaya (Contiguity Condition)** *Yasmim samaye kāmāvacaram kusalam cittam uppannam hoti somanassasahagatam ñāṇasampayuttam,* *samanantarapaccayena paccayo.* *At the time when a wholesome sense-sphere consciousness has arisen accompanied by joy and associated with knowledge, [it is] a condition by way of contiguity condition.* **1.1.1.6. Sahajātapaccaya (Conascence Condition)** *Yasmim samaye kāmāvacaram kusalam cittam uppannam hoti somanassasahagatam ñāṇasampayuttam,* *sahajātapaccayena paccayo.* *At the time when a wholesome sense-sphere consciousness has arisen accompanied by joy and associated with knowledge, [it is] a condition by way of conascence condition.* **1.1.1.7. Aññamaññapaccaya (Mutuality Condition)** *Yasmim samaye kāmāvacaram kusalam cittam uppannam hoti somanassasahagatam ñāṇasampayuttam,* *aññamaññapaccayena paccayo.* *At the time when a wholesome sense-sphere consciousness has arisen accompanied by joy and associated with knowledge, [it is] a condition by way of mutuality condition.* **1.1.1.8. Nissayapaccaya (Support Condition)** *Yasmim samaye kāmāvacaram kusalam cittam uppannam hoti somanassasahagatam ñāṇasampayuttam,* *nissayapaccayena paccayo.* *At the time when a wholesome sense-sphere consciousness has arisen accompanied by joy and associated with knowledge, [it is] a condition by way of support condition.* **1.1.1.9. Upanissayapaccaya (Decisive Support Condition)** *Yasmim samaye kāmāvacaram kusalam cittam uppannam hoti somanassasahagatam ñāṇasampayuttam,* *upanissayapaccayena paccayo.* *At the time when a wholesome sense-sphere consciousness has arisen accompanied by joy and associated with knowledge, [it is] a condition by way of decisive support condition.* **1.1.1.10. Purejātapaccaya (Prenascence Condition)** *Yasmim samaye kāmāvacaram kusalam cittam uppannam hoti somanassasahagatam ñāṇasampayuttam,* *purejātapaccayena paccayo.* *At the time when a wholesome sense-sphere consciousness has arisen accompanied by joy and associated with knowledge, [it is] a condition by way of prenascence condition.* **1.1.1.11. Pacchājātapaccaya (Postnascence Condition)** *Yasmim samaye kāmāvacaram kusalam cittam uppannam hoti somanassasahagatam ñāṇasampayuttam,* *pacchājātapaccayena paccayo.* *At the time when a wholesome sense-sphere consciousness has arisen accompanied by joy and associated with knowledge, [it is] a condition by way of postnascence condition.* **1.1.1.12. Āsevanapaccaya (Repetition Condition)** *Yasmim samaye kāmāvacaram kusalam cittam uppannam hoti somanassasahagatam ñāṇasampayuttam,* *āsevanapaccayena paccayo.* *At the time when a wholesome sense-sphere consciousness has arisen accompanied by joy and associated with knowledge, [it is] a condition by way of repetition condition.* **1.1.1.13. Kammapaccaya (Kamma Condition)** *Yasmim samaye kāmāvacaram kusalam cittam uppannam hoti somanassasahagatam ñāṇasampayuttam,* *kammapaccayena paccayo.* *At the time when a wholesome sense-sphere consciousness has arisen accompanied by joy and associated with knowledge, [it is] a condition by way of kamma condition.* **1.1.1.14. Vipākappaccaya (Resultant Condition)** *Yasmim samaye kāmāvacaram kusalam cittam uppannam hoti somanassasahagatam ñāṇasampayuttam,* *vipākappaccayena paccayo.* *At the time when a wholesome sense-sphere consciousness has arisen accompanied by joy and associated with knowledge, [it is] a condition by way of resultant condition.* **1.1.1.15. Āhārapaccaya (Nutriment Condition)** *Yasmim samaye kāmāvacaram kusalam cittam uppannam hoti somanassasahagatam ñāṇasampayuttam,* *āhārapaccayena paccayo.* *At the time when a wholesome sense-sphere consciousness has arisen accompanied by joy and associated with knowledge, [it is] a condition by way of nutriment condition.* **1.1.1.16. Indriyapaccaya (Faculty Condition)** *Yasmim samaye kāmāvacaram kusalam cittam uppannam hoti somanassasahagatam ñāṇasampayuttam,* *indriyapaccayena paccayo.* *At the time when a wholesome sense-sphere consciousness has arisen accompanied by joy and associated with knowledge, [it is] a condition by way of faculty condition.* **1.1.1.
